triage_rules: Use stable issue IDs to group observations across runs.
Keep historical validation separate from current-branch status.
Recheck main and feat/suggested-changes; a later commit may already repair an issue.
Retain rejected/modified findings and their rationale in review-records.json.
Do not automatically turn a performance hypothesis or conservative safety tradeoff into a blocking defect.
